records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: result:user-scope plugin updated from 0.38.2 to 0.38.3 and is enabled; a new session is required to apply it
result:all 144 distributed files in the installed cache are byte-for-byte identical to git archive v0.38.3

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-hook
evidence: host:a new Claude Code CLI session loaded the installed v0.38.3 plugin from its cache and ran in an isolated synthetic Git project
result:one UserPromptSubmit hook response machine event carried the valid MAP_ONLY stage and Claude exited 0
limit:the synthetic project contained no real repository content; this proves installed Claude Code hook injection, not Claude Desktop behavior

records.subject: spec-guard-local-ticket-reply
evidence: host:a fresh Claude Code CLI session used the installed v0.38.3 ticket command and skill against one synthetic Epiq issue in an isolated repository and isolated EPIQ_GLOBAL_DIR
result:epiq_issue_list actually ran; the user reply contained the read title and short reference, omitted the full internal ID, and no ticket write tool was called
limit:this proves the installed-version synthetic reply path, not a response over the user's real Local ledger

records.subject: spec-guard-real-local-ticket-reply
records.reason: Automatic approval review rejected sending the real Local ledger contents to an external Claude model because disclosure of those specific records was not authorized. No real ticket was read by that host test; the synthetic test above is the available evidence.

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-desktop
records.reason: Claude Desktop is a separate delivery surface and was not exercised by the Claude Code CLI tests.
